description: Implementation of the TopologyTask class for managing network topology discovery, neighbor management, and related TLV message handling in a prplMesh agent.

classes.name: TopologyTask
classes.description: Manages network topology discovery, neighbor device management, and message handling in a prplMesh agent.

methods.name: convert_bandwidth
methods.description: Converts internal WiFi bandwidth enum to IEEE 802.11 bandwidth code.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs periodic topology discovery, neighbor cleanup, and notification sending.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles specific events such as device initialization.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages based on their type.

methods.name: handle_topology_discovery
methods.description: Handles received topology discovery messages, updates neighbor list, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: handle_topology_query
methods.description: Responds to topology query messages with device and neighbor information.

methods.name: handle_vendor_specific
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific messages, currently client association/disconnection notifications.

methods.name: handle_vs_client_associated
methods.description: Placeholder for handling client associated notifications.

methods.name: handle_vs_client_disassociated
methods.description: Placeholder for handling client disassociated notifications.

methods.name: send_topology_discovery
methods.description: Sends topology discovery messages on all active interfaces.

methods.name: send_topology_notification
methods.description: Sends topology notification messages when topology info changes.

methods.name: add_device_information_tlv
methods.description: Adds device information TLV with interface details.

methods.name: add_1905_neighbor_device_tlv

methods.name: add_non_1905_neighbor_device_tlv
methods.description: Adds TLV for non-1905 neighbor devices.

methods.name: add_supported_service_tlv
methods.description: Adds supported service TLV.

methods.name: add_ap_operational_bss_tlv
methods.description: Adds AP operational BSS TLV.

methods.name: add_associated_clients_tlv
methods.description: Adds associated clients TLV.

methods.description: Adds vendor-specific TLV mapping BSSID to interface.

methods.name: add_assoc_sta_mld_config_reports
methods.description: Adds associated STA MLD configuration reports.

methods.description: Adds BSS configuration report TLV.
